question: Should OpenClaw remove these shipped root bundled skills now and make Sherpa ONNX TTS an official ClawHub-only plugin in the same release change?
rationale: The implementation changes the supported starter set, upgrade behavior, official install trust, dependency graph, and native artifact distribution; code inspection cannot decide the intended deprecation and release boundary.

options.title: Require migration and trust proof
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not merge until doctor migration coverage, ClawHub availability, current-head dependency authorization, and Sherpa artifact provenance are demonstrated.

options.title: Split Sherpa packaging
options.body: Move the independently useful Sherpa external-plugin work into a narrower PR and defer the broad bundled-skill removal.

options.title: Retain the bundled set
options.body: Close or park this branch and keep the current shipped skill set until a future release owns a deprecation plan.

recommendation.title: Require migration and trust proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but do not merge until doctor migration coverage, ClawHub availability, current-head dependency authorization, and Sherpa artifact provenance are demonstrated.
